Name: Lumisteria Spring Furniture
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
You can find this mod and other of furniture mods updated from 1.6 and bundled together here : https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26505

This mod adds several spring-themed furniture based on the theme of the modding contest on SDV discord.

- Several posters of bugs to decorate your house. These posters are inspired by various existing insects but don't intend to be realistic !
- A bunny plush, with two other plushes (an elephant and a tiger), to go with the Large Bear plush.
- A set of furniture decorated with cherry blossom
